title: ItipReceptor
description: ITIP base Archetype for Receptor — a Structure's inbound causal port. Inherits gsm/Receptor through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Receptor statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Receptor, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
